UNIC is a European university alliance of ten universities from cities including Bochum, Cork, Rotterdam, Bilbao, Koper, Liège, Zagreb, Ankara, Helsinki and Malmö. Beyond joint degrees, its REPIC and related programmes publish rolling calls for courses, workshops, winter/summer schools and staff-student exchanges through the year.

Programme Highlights

  • Ten-university alliance with continuous call calendar
  • REPIC and allied programmes fund collaborative courses and mobility
  • Deadlines are call-specific rather than annual
  • Useful channel for students already enrolled at a UNIC member university

Who Should Apply

Most UNIC calls target students and staff already enrolled or employed at member universities, so check your home institution's eligibility route first.

Funding and Costs

Mobility support and grants depend on the specific call; most student programmes are run through home-university funding. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Browse the UNIC opportunities page and follow the individual call instructions; each lists its own deadline and application route. Key deadline information: Multiple calls per year — each course, workshop and call carries its own deadline on the UNIC portal.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About UNIC European University Alliance

UNIC is a European Universities alliance of ten comprehensive universities committed to inclusive higher education, superdiversity and collaborative research and teaching programmes across Europe.

Official website: https://www.unic.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Multiple calls per year - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
